_comment: VOM compat for the gem ore blocktype. See ore-graded.json for the full mechanism and why the cube is a SINGLE fixed sides/1 + required ore overlay (per-block stone variation is unreachable on the JSON/doMesh path; overlay paints the ore). Gem lumps are the polished gem block texture (diamond/emerald/olivine), falling back to the ungraded ore item for the rest. Unqualified = game domain; Conquest rock cube base; Universal mod so it applies server-side.
